cancellationPolicyPassengerWindow: Passengers may cancel their reservation within 5 minutes of booking. After 5 minutes, a cancellation fee applies.
cancellationPolicyDriverLate: If the driver arrives more than 20 minutes later than the agreed time and proof is provided, the passenger may submit a compensation claim for 2% of the ride amount.
cancellationPolicyPassengerLate: If the passenger is more than 10 minutes late, does not show up, or cannot be contacted, the driver may cancel the ride. In this case, 45% of the ride amount is refunded.
cancellationPolicyWaitingFee: At European airports, waiting time may be estimated at EUR 0.15 per minute only after the driver agrees to wait.
cancellationPolicyRefundTiming: Refunds for online payments are processed within 4 business days.
cancellationPolicyCancel1: Free cancellation within 5 minutes of making the reservation.
cancellationPolicyCancel2: After 5 minutes from making the reservation, the customer receives 45% of the ride amount back. The refund is processed within 3 business days.
cancellationPolicyCancel3: If the driver arrives more than 20 minutes late and the customer can prove this via chat messages or screenshots of calls, the customer receives compensation of 5% of the ride amount. This compensation is paid out within 3 business days.
cancellationPolicyCancel4: In the event of a no-show, the driver may wait a maximum of 10 minutes. After these 10 minutes, the ride is automatically cancelled. The customer then receives 45% of the ride amount back within 3 business days.
cancellationPolicyAirport1: For airport rides, a free waiting time of 30 minutes applies after the agreed arrival time.
cancellationPolicyAirport2: If the customer is not present within these 30 minutes, a waiting fee of €0.15 per minute is charged, provided the driver agrees to continue waiting.
cancellationPolicyAirport3: If the driver does not agree to continue waiting after the free 30-minute waiting time, the ride is cancelled and the customer receives 45% of the ride amount back within 3 business days.
cancellationPolicyCancelDialog: Free cancellation within 5 minutes of booking. After 5 minutes, you will receive 45% of the fare back. Refunds for online payments are processed within 4 business days.

privacyPolicyIntro: Fat7i processes personal data in accordance with the AVG/GDPR regulations.
privacyPolicyDataCollectedBody:
• Name
• Phone number
• Email address
• Pickup and drop-off address
• GPS location
• Payment details
• Device information
privacyPolicyPurposesBody:
• Booking and carrying out taxi rides
• Contact between customer and driver
• Customer service
• Payment processing
• Fraud prevention
• Improvement of the service
privacyPolicyRightsBody:
• Access to data
• Correction of data
• Deletion of data
• Withdrawal of consent
privacyPolicyAccountDeletionBody: Users can delete their account through the app or by email. Requests are processed within 30 days.

• Free cancellation up to 24 hours before departure.
• Within 24 hours, charges may apply.
• In case of a no-show, the full ride amount may be charged.
